placements.title: Erasing What Was Never Established
placements.theme: When knowledge is recognized as never having been legitimately established, it must be actively removed from the record.
placements.why: All three segments cohere under a single thematic subject: the directive to forget and remove knowledge about the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration (src-1, src-2), grounded by the assertion that the observatory never calibrated it (src-3). No existing narrative leaf or strata category covers erasure, removal of knowledge, or record correction — the graph is empty. This names a subject future envelopes could feed (knowledge removal, record correction, erasure directives), not a one-time fact, so it clears the narrative grain test.
